notes: Open mSupply is the mSupply Foundation's open-source LMIS for public health supply chains. It has no REST API and publishes no OpenAPI: the whole server surface is one GraphQL endpoint, POST {baseUrl}/graphql, body {query, variables}, response {data, errors}. upstream.json is the verbatim GraphQL introspection document fetched from the vendor's own demo server (apiVersion 3.4.0), and openapi.json is a mechanical conversion of it: every root field of Queries (164) and Mutations (166) becomes one operation, and every named GraphQL type (634 objects, 356 inputs, 281 unions, 135 enums, 123 interfaces) becomes a component schema, so this is the whole schema and not the slice the adaptor selects. Coverage is therefore full and the conversion is complete for query/mutation operations. Two deliberate modelling choices: (1) OpenAPI 3.0 allows one operation per method per path, so each root field is a distinct '/graphql#<field>' path variant carrying its own operationId and response envelope — at runtime every one of them is the same POST /graphql, and the generic '/graphql' operation (graphqlRequest) is the adaptor's query() helper; (2) output object schemas declare no required properties, because a GraphQL response only carries the fields the caller's selection set asked for, so even a non-null field is absent unless selected. Not converted as operations: the three Subscriptions root fields (ping, syncInfoUpdated, initialisationStatusUpdated), which are served over the GraphQL subscription transport rather than an HTTP POST; their types are still present under components.schemas. The adaptor surface was cross-checked against the schema — getItemsWithStats runs root field 'items', insertOutboundShipment runs 'insertOutboundShipment', upsertOutboundShipment runs 'batchOutboundShipment', and the implicit login runs the 'authToken' query — all four exist in upstream.json with the argument names the adaptor passes. The specUrl is a live server, so upstream.contentHash will move whenever the demo is upgraded; that is a genuine upstream-changed signal, not a capture error. servers[0].url is the vendor demo; real deployments are self-hosted and set by the adaptor's baseUrl credential. Re-captured 2026-11-16 after the demo server was upgraded from 3.1.0 to 3.4.0. The converter is not in this repo, so it was re-implemented and shown to reproduce the previous openapi.json byte-for-byte from the previous upstream.json before being run on the new introspection document; its rules, for the next refresh: upstream.json is the response body of the classic graphql-js introspection query (__schema { queryType mutationType subscriptionType types { ...FullType } directives }, fields and enumValues with includeDeprecated: true, TypeRef nested 7 ofType levels); scalars and __ introspection types are inlined or skipped (String/ID string, Int int32, Float double, Boolean, DateTime and NaiveDateTime date-time, NaiveDate date, JSON an untyped 'Arbitrary JSON value.', JSONObject a free-form object); objects and interfaces get a leading __typename property and no required list; inputs list their NON_NULL fields as required; nullable fields carry nullable: true; descriptions are whitespace-collapsed; unions are oneOf; each root field gets a <Field>Envelope schema and a /graphql#<field> path (a mutation whose name collides with a query takes a Mutation suffix: centralServerMutation), with the summary taken from the field description's first sentence (120 characters at most). The one curated input is the root-field-to-tag table: existing fields keep their tags, and the 22 new root fields were assigned by hand to existing tags (prescription request operations -> prescriptions, barcode proposals/matches -> barcodes, sync pause flags -> sync, maintenance mode and processor flags -> server, periodSchedules -> periods, requisitionLineForecastPreview -> requisitions, allocatePatientNumber -> patients). What moved 3.1.0 -> 3.4.0: +12 queries (areProcessorsPaused, barcodeMatches, isMaintenanceMode, isSyncApiPaused, isSyncPaused, itemBarcodeProposals, itemBarcodes, maintenanceMode, periodSchedules, prescriptionRequest, prescriptionRequests, requisitionLineForecastPreview) and +10 mutations (allocatePatientNumber, batchPrescriptionRequest, deleteBarcodeProposal, deletePrescriptionRequest, deletePrescriptionRequestLine, insertPrescriptionRequest, proposeBarcode, setSyncPaused, updatePrescriptionRequest, upsertPrescriptionRequestLine); no root field was removed; 82 types added, 2 removed (CannotEditAdjustedQuantity, CannotEditQuantityBelowReceived), 81 changed. Totals are now 331 operations (330 root fields plus the generic /graphql) and 1862 component schemas.
